errors.evidence: The x-axis range starts at 10^0, not 10^1 as stated in the description.
The y-axis tick marks are at intervals of 5, starting from 40, not at 0, 40, 50, and 60.

errors.text_span: FT (blue, solid line with triangle markers)
errors.evidence: FT is represented by inverted triangular markers, not triangle markers.

errors.text_span: MEMIT (purple, solid line with circle markers)
errors.evidence: MEMIT is represented by pentagon markers, not circle markers.
The ROME method reaches approximately 66%, not over 65%. The y-axis maxes out at 65, so 'over 65%' is misleading.
The description omits mentioning the total number of lines (six) in the initial summary, though it lists five methods.
The description fails to mention the 'IKE' method entirely.
